tool.name: OGS: CreateAnchors
tool.description: Computes natual coordinates from given real coordinates
tool.command: ln -sf '$input' 'input.vtu'; ln -sf '$json_file' 'json_file.json'; CreateAnchors --input 'input.vtu' --json-file 'json_file.json' #if str($tolerance) --tolerance '$tolerance' #end if #if str($max_iter) --max-iter '$max_iter' #end if --output output_1.vtu

param.label: json file
param.help: Input (.json) JSON file containing anchor start and end points

param.label: max iter
param.help: maximum number of iterations of the internal root-finding algorithm

tool.help: Computes natual coordinates from given real coordinates
